<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g aria-label="Status bar">
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4A4A4A">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="26" x2="325" y2="26" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="23" x2="325" y2="23" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="319" y1="20" x2="325" y2="20" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="23" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="20" x2="341" y2="26" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="352" y="17" width="25" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="354" y="19" width="18" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <rect x="377" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Onboarding header">
    <polyline points="34,91 25,100 34,109" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="26" y1="100" x2="45" y2="100" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="70" y="96" width="250" height="7" rx="4" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="70" y="96" width="156" height="7" rx="4" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <text x="340" y="103" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">4 of 8</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="158" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Who do you want to see?</text>
  <text x="195" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose your gender preference</text>

  <g aria-label="Woman option" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="23" y="211" width="344" height="76" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="249" r="22" fill="#FFF0F4"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="242" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="63" cy="262" rx="11" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="101" y="255" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Woman</text>
    <circle cx="335" cy="249" r="11" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <polyline points="329,249 333,253 341,245" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Man option" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="23" y="305" width="344" height="76" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="343" r="22" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="336" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="63" cy="356" rx="11" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#7D8490" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="101" y="349" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Man</text>
    <circle cx="335" cy="343" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Other option" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="23" y="399" width="344" height="76" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="437" r="22" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="56" cy="437" r="4" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="437" r="4" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="430" r="4" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <text x="101" y="443" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Other</text>
    <circle cx="335" cy="437" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Preference note">
    <rect x="24" y="505" width="342" height="62" rx="14" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="536" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="50" y="541" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#939393">i</text>
    <text x="75" y="532" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">You can change this anytime</text>
    <text x="75" y="550" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">in your discovery settings.</text>
  </g>

  <g aria-label="Continue button" filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="54" y="610" width="282" height="48" rx="24" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="640" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="683" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your preference helps personalize your experience.</text>

  <line x1="0" y1="724" x2="390" y2="724" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g aria-label="Bottom navigation">
    <g transform="translate(39,744)">
      <polygon points="0,10 12,0 24,10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="5" y="9" width="14" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(116,744)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="9" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="12,4 13.5,7.5 17,8 14.5,10.5 15,14" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(202,744)">
      <rect x="2" y="4" width="21" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="7,20 7,25 12,20" fill="#939393"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="10" x2="17" y2="10" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="14" x2="14" y2="14" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Chats</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(286,744)">
      <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="12" cy="20" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="12" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <rect x="145" y="827" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000" opacity="0.75"/>
</svg>
